description: This file provides a function 'formatGeneratedModule' that formats source code using an external formatter tool, either 'oxfmt' directly or via 'pnpm', with temporary file management and error handling.

methods.name: formatGeneratedModule
methods.description: Formats a source code string by writing it to a temporary file, running an external formatter ('oxfmt' or via 'pnpm'), and returning the formatted code.
